So in essence yes Republicans do have a majority in the Senate, but they don't have a 60 vote supermajority. It is theoretically possible that if there is crazy turnout for this year's elections that they could get a supermajority, but it would require Trump to make this crystal clear to voters and for voters to get off their ass to make that happen.
